faq.question: How does Kommently work?
faq.answer: Paste a live URL or upload a file, then click anywhere to leave precise visual comments. Comments stay anchored to the page context for designers, developers, and stakeholders.

faq.question: Do guests need an account to review?
faq.answer: No. You can share controlled review links with clients or external collaborators so they can comment without creating an account.

faq.question: What file types can I review in Kommently?
faq.answer: Kommently supports live websites, PDFs, images, and launch assets so teams can keep feedback in one workflow.

faq.question: Can my team collaborate in real time?
faq.answer: Yes. Comments, replies, presence, and status changes update in real time so teams avoid duplicate notes and slow handoffs.

faq.question: Can I try Kommently for free before paying?
faq.answer: Yes. Starter and Pro include a free trial so your team can run a real review before choosing a plan.

faq.question: Do client reviewers count as members?
faq.answer: Guests are separate from team members. You can invite clients through controlled review links without adding them to your internal workspace.

faq.question: Can we cancel monthly plans?
faq.answer: Yes. Monthly plans can be cancelled any time from billing settings.
